name: Nijmegen bridges, 19–20 September 1944 (provisional)
description: From 12:00 on 19 September to 20:00 on 20 September 1944. The Guards Armoured Division has reached the US 82nd Airborne Division south of Nijmegen. The Allied side must seize the Waal road bridge and hold a supplied bridgehead on both ends of it by the end. The German side must deny that, or cut the corridor at the Heumen lock bridge. Researched from published histories but provisional: strengths, positions and equipment are estimates where the sources are silent. See docs/research.

objectives.name: Seize the Nijmegen road bridge

notes: Every unit, event and number is provisional: no data has been checked against Margry, Kershaw or the WO 171 war diaries yet. Open questions are listed in docs/research/allied-forces.md section 7 and german-forces.md section 10.

Map: RD New grid, 1 km hexes. Woods from the 1938-42 Dutch forest survey (Netherlands) and OpenStreetMap (Germany); towns, roads and bridges from the 1944 research; polder from EU-DEM heights. See tools/map-builder.

Modelling choices: the Waal assault-boat crossing is a foot-only Allied crossing from turn 14 (boats arrived about 14:30 on 20 Sep); the Waal railway bridge carries infantry only; the damaged Honinghutje bridge carries no tanks; Allied road supply starts at 06:00 on 20 Sep.

Units grouped for one-counter-per-hex: Kampfgruppe Euling includes the SS pioneers and the four armoured vehicles at Hunner Park; the 80th Airborne AA Bn's 57 mm guns are attached to the battalions they supported.
Night is not modelled: spotting works the same in daylight and darkness.
